exposure: History of lower segment Caesarean section
cohort: 340 lactating mothers and their infants in the Guntur district of Andhra Pradesh, India
finding: The study found that 19.71% of tribal mothers were underweight at baseline and that undernutrition was associated with Yenadi tribe, low educational status of the mother, history of lower segment Caesarean section, and having older children.
mod_finding: History of lower segment Caesarean section was associated with a high prevalence of being underweight.
